memberdef.name: PASS_DESC
memberdef.initializer: "Lower buffer fat pointer operations to buffer resources"

briefdescription.para: Return the ptr addrspace(8) and i32 (resource and offset parts) in a lowered buffer fat pointer constant.
Returns the instruction that defines the resource part of the value V.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this is not getUnderlyingObject(), since that looks through operations like ptrmask which might modify the resource part.

We can limit ourselves to just looking through GEPs followed by looking through addrspacecasts because only those two operations preserve the resource part, and because operations on an addrspace(8) (which is the legal input to this addrspacecast) would produce a different resource part.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if this intrinsic needs to be removed when it is applied to ptr addrspace(7) values.

detaileddescription.para: Calls to these intrinsics are rewritten into calls to versions of that intrinsic on the resource descriptor.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if there are values that have a buffer fat pointer in them, which means we'll need to perform rewrites on this function.

detaileddescription.para: As a side effect, this will populate the type remapping cache.

briefdescription.para: Move the body of OldF into a new function, returning it.
